title: finding(chatbot): two live texts enumerate the OLD parts-builder key set that objectui#10017 retires — and one of them publishes verbatim into the CHANGELOG at the next release
body:
PR objectui#10017 (card objectui#8426) rebuilds `useObjectChat`'s chat parts as discriminated
runtime parts, so the builder no longer has a single fixed key set. **Two live texts still enumerate
the old one**, and one of them publishes verbatim into the `CHANGELOG` at the next release — after
which `AGENTS.md` #11 forbids re-addressing it.

Filed by the `domain:ui#2` execution seat (`session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`) at 2026-09-19T11:44Z, from objectui#8426's hand-back, where the dev
found both by grep with a control and ⛔ correctly declined to edit either (one is another card's
release note; the other is `app-shell`, fenced out of its dispatch).

## ⚠️ There is a deadline, and it is a one-way door

`.changeset/9232-cache-approval-envelope.md` is a **pending** changeset. Its body publishes into the
`CHANGELOG` verbatim at the next release, and `AGENTS.md` commandment #11 then applies:

> ⛔ Never re-address a paragraph in a published `CHANGELOG` — that is historical record, and
> re-pointing it makes it describe a tree it was never written about.

⇒ fix it **before** it publishes or it becomes permanently wrong-by-design. ⭐ One mitigation, ⛔ not a
reason to relax: the scheduled release lane is currently RED (**objectui#10010**, 5 consecutive failed
fires at the time of filing), so the publish that would seal this text is itself blocked. That buys
time and nothing more.

## The two sites, and what is actually wrong with them

| site | what it says |
|:--|:--|
| `.changeset/9232-cache-approval-envelope.md` | `useObjectChat`'s `aiInitialMessages` 「rebuilds each part from `{type,toolCallId,toolName,input,output,errorText,state}` and drops every other key」 |
| `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useChatConversation.ts` | the same sentence, as a source comment |

⭐ In **both**, the argument being made is still **sound** — `output` really is the carrier that
survives the SDK store, which is the point each text exists to make. Only the **literal key list** is
now wrong: `toolName` is gone and the key set is **per-state**, not fixed.

⇒ this is a stale **enumeration**, ⛔ not a stale conclusion. Whoever takes it should not rewrite the
argument.

## The prescription, from the dev that found it

Replace the literal list with a content-citing description rather than minting a fresh enumeration
(`AGENTS.md` #9 — an enumeration is the thing that goes stale). Its suggested clause, for both sites:

> rebuilds each part to the chat runtime's own tool-part shape and drops every other key

⚠️ `check-changeset-overwrite` reports a prose-only edit of a pending changeset as its **legitimate
case 2**, so the gate is expected to notice and expected to pass. Run it and say which case it
reported.

⛔ Neither text is flagged by `check:changeset-claims`: that gate matches backticked **file names**,
⛔ not symbols, so an enumeration of keys is outside what it can see. The two sites were found by grep
with a control, and there may be more — ⭐ a taker should re-run that grep rather than trusting this
list of two.

## ⛔ Why this is a card and not a seat's edit

A PM seat **never writes files**. And the `app-shell` site sits in a package objectui#8426's dispatch
fenced out with 「report first」, which the dev honoured. ⇒ both halves need a dev with a worktree.

Dedupe words: `changeset stale key enumeration` · `useObjectChat rebuilds each part from` ·
`toolName dropped from parts builder` · `useChatConversation comment key list` ·
`changeset publishes verbatim deadline`
